title: Does zero-demonstration introspection training induce an adaptive latent-axis reader, and what is its generalization kernel?
motivation: Existing post-hoc analysis shows that codebook-trained reporters can solve four-row matched-visible latent-XOR quartets on arbitrary random axes, while the untrained model cannot. Existing held-out semantic results show near-zero quartet generalization to a new exemplar despite a nearly perfect cheap adaptive reader. The missing causal factorial is to train one zero-demonstration reporter, save it, and evaluate every interface on that same checkpoint.

model.name: qwen-3b
model.training_recipe: exactly report_training_v3 except adapter MUST be saved; do not tune from any evaluation below

primary_estimand.name: latent_xor_quartet_accuracy
primary_estimand.definition: Four rows share a byte-identical visible prompt. Two hidden demonstration configurations encode opposite latent sign-to-label conventions, crossed with two hidden query signs. Success requires all four labels correct.
primary_estimand.why: Visible-only, query-only-hidden, demonstration-only-hidden, constant-label, and fixed sign-to-token strategies cannot solve all four rows. This is stricter than reporting query twins and mapping flips separately.

evaluation_battery.name: A_original_zero_demo
evaluation_battery.purpose: Reproduce the training endpoint and retain specificity diagnostics.

evaluation_battery.name: B_same_axis_latent_icl
evaluation_battery.purpose: Test whether zero-demo training transfers to learning a hidden codebook from demonstrations, without ever training on demonstration-based codebook episodes.
evaluation_battery.critical_comparison: trained minus base on arbitrary random latent-XOR quartets

evaluation_battery.name: C_cross_axis_geometry_kernel
evaluation_battery.purpose: Map whether latent-code transfer is exact-axis or geometric.
evaluation_battery.construction: For each held-out random base axis u, construct query axes v with prospectively fixed cosine(u,v) in {0.95,0.8,0.6,0.3,0.0}; orthogonal components are independently seeded and norm matched. Demonstrations use u; query uses v. The + orientation of v is defined as the same latent class as +u by construction.
evaluation_battery.prediction_if_geometric: accuracy decreases monotonically with cosine and approaches structural floor near zero cosine

evaluation_battery.name: D_semantic_cross_axis
evaluation_battery.purpose: Test whether training creates abstraction beyond geometric similarity.
evaluation_battery.design: Rerun the frozen heldout_semantic_v1 exemplar assignment on the same saved checkpoint, preserving semantic, scrambled, random, same-exemplar and query-only arms.
evaluation_battery.critical_comparison: heldout_semantic minus heldout_scrambled after matching or stratifying by demo-query geometry

evaluation_battery.name: E_native_polarity_override
evaluation_battery.purpose: Test true same-checkpoint rebinding rather than cross-adapter inference.
evaluation_battery.design: Measure each random axis's no-demo Q-K slope on the saved checkpoint. Then use that exact axis in demonstrations whose hidden convention requires the opposite output polarity. Counterbalance both mappings and query signs.
evaluation_battery.metric: latent_xor_quartet_accuracy stratified by aligned versus anti-aligned native polarity
evaluation_battery.kill_rule: If anti-aligned performance collapses while aligned remains high, adaptive rebinding is not established.

evaluation_battery.name: F_true_no_signal
evaluation_battery.purpose: Measure false-positive/abstention behavior rather than arbitrary-axis decoding.
evaluation_battery.design: Demonstrations contain valid hidden states. Query has no edit and response vocabulary includes UNKNOWN in addition to Q/K. Freeze wording and label-token choices before running.
evaluation_battery.success: trained model does not become more confidently binary on no-edit queries than base while retaining B/D gains

controls.visible_prompt_hashing: Every latent-XOR quartet must assert one prompt_sha256 across all four rows.
controls.query_only_hidden: No quartet success is possible when demonstration edits are removed.
controls.demo_only_hidden: No quartet success is possible when query edit is removed; score UNKNOWN arm instead.
controls.cheap_reader: Run the same four-shot centroid/euclidean reader on captured states; reader establishes state-level capacity, not privileged access.
controls.labels: Use semantically inert single-token labels and verify first-token IDs/frequencies before freeze.
controls.adapter: save_pretrained immediately after training, hash all files, and never retrain between evaluation arms

predeclared_interpretation.exact_axis_only: B improves but C decays rapidly and D semantic does not beat scrambled: training creates an adaptive same-axis latent reader, not semantic introspection.
predeclared_interpretation.geometric_kernel: C follows cosine and D is explained by geometry: training creates geometric latent relation transfer.
predeclared_interpretation.semantic_abstraction: D semantic robustly exceeds geometry-matched scrambled while reader gate remains high: evidence training induces semantic cross-axis generalization.
predeclared_interpretation.no_transfer_from_zero_demo_training: A reproduces but B random remains near base: earlier arbitrary latent-ICL capability was specific to codebook training, not generic introspection training.
predeclared_interpretation.specificity_failure: F becomes confidently Q/K on no-edit queries: training gains come with a real no-signal calibration cost.

research_os_priority: B same-axis latent ICL on zero-demo-trained checkpoint
D held-out semantic on same checkpoint
